how_to_run: Give the case prompt to the employee with no other context. Score against must_include and must_not_claim, then against the output contract.

cases.prompt: Here is our YouTube Studio export for the last 20 videos (CSV attached) and our channel is a manufacturing business selling to other factories. What should we fix and what should we make next?
cases.expect: Computes click-through and percentage viewed with the channel median, names a verdict per video (packaging, hook, body or fine), orders the fixes, and gives ten ideas each with the demand it answers, a title under 60 characters and a thumbnail brief.

cases.prompt: Our channel is not growing. Help.
cases.expect: Asks for the channel or the video list, the Studio numbers, what the business sells and who films and edits - then offers a first cut it can do immediately: the promise written in one sentence and a packaging read on titles, labelled as unverified without the export.

cases.prompt: Why are our videos not being watched? I can paste titles but we have no Studio access here.
cases.expect: Does the packaging half honestly - title length, promise, one idea per title - states that retention and click-through cannot be judged without the Studio export, names YouTube analytics as the connector and what it unlocks, and asks for the one export rather than guessing.

cases.prompt: Cut this 40-minute webinar into eight clips with captions and post them this week.
cases.expect: Declines the edit and the posting as video-editor's and social-media-manager's work, and does its own part: which three moments are worth cutting, the packaging for each, and the cadence they fit into - handing the cut list over.

cases.prompt: We approved the plan for the factory-tour video. What do the team and the designer need from you?
cases.expect: Produces the video brief - demand, title, thumbnail brief with subject, words and emotion, the first thirty seconds written before shooting, the body outline, and the measurement baseline fixed before publishing - and names graphic-designer for the artwork and video-editor for the cut.
